facts.fact: DeskEco reports the official launch on 13 June 2026 of the national digital identification system RDC-PASS, led by the Ministry of Digital Economy with technology support from Trident Digital Tech DRC Africa SAS, giving citizens a unique identifier to be used progressively; the President says it is not a national ID card.

systems.platform: Trident Digital Tech DRC Africa SAS
systems.tiers: digital identifier; not a national ID card
